title: Hearty Grapy Irish Figs Bake
description: Grassy, flaky, Irish dish featuring figs, double-rise-bread, and a touch of paleo-friendliness, all wrapped in a banana leaf.

ingredients.name: Figs
ingredients.notes: fresh, preferably from local farmers market

instructions: Bring 1 cup of almond milk to a simmer in a saucepan, add a pinch of salt, and let it reduce for 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, combine 1 cup of almond flour, 2 tbsp of sorghum syrup, and 1 tsp of baking soda.
Gradually add the wet mixture to the dry mixture and fold until well combined.
Add 12 fresh figs, cut in half, and mix until they're evenly distributed in the dough.
Using 4 banana leaves, create small cups or molds and fill each one with the dough.
Place the banana leaf cups on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the figs are baking, melt 2 tbsp of coconut oil and 1 tbsp of butter in a saucepan over low heat.
Add 1 cup of grapes to the saucepan and let them simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Once the figs are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Place a spoonful of the grape sauce on top of each fig, followed by a sprinkle of chopped kale.
Garnish with fresh grapes and serve immediately.
